scripts.dev:all: (cd app1 && npm run dev) & (cd app2 && npm run dev) & (cd portal && npm run dev) & wait
scripts.build:all: (cd app1 && npm run build) & (cd app2 && npm run build) & (cd portal && npm run build) & wait
scripts.start:all: (cd app1 && npm run start) & (cd app2 && npm run start) & (cd portal && npm run start) & wait
scripts.stop:all: for p in 3000 3002 3010; do pid=$(lsof -tiTCP:$p -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then kill $pid; fi; done
scripts.lint:all: cd app1 && npm run lint && cd ../app2 && npm run lint && cd ../portal && npm run lint
